note: Snapshot used to price steps; its sha256 is recorded on every step as cost.pricing_snapshot_hash and the bytes are stored in the BlobStore at startup, so a charge is explainable after prices change. Models not listed are priced 0 and marked priced=false in the step output. Override with AGENTOS_OPENAI_AGENTS_PRICING=/path/to/pricing.json.
free_prefixes_note: Locally served open-weight families (Ollama, vLLM) are priced 0 and marked priced=true: running them costs electricity, not an invoice.
